_comment: An add-on that ships a node_modules folder. The name buys it nothing here: an add-on is the bytes a user installs, so the folder is walked, keyed and reviewed like any other - the eval inside it is reported at its own path, and the folder is reported unused like any other unreferenced folder. committed-node-modules is deliberately ABSENT: that check is sca:true, because an installed tree is build output only in a SOURCE submission, where the reviewer installs it from the declared manifest and lock. This is the XPI half of that rule; build-hygiene-sca is the source half.
